traps.wrong: Linewatch ran on a production line or prevented defects in service.
traps.truth: It is an offline prototype evaluated on archived images. It has not been deployed or tested live.

traps.wrong: The model has 98% accuracy or 98% recall for rare defects, without asking which metric the headline means.
traps.truth: 98% is overall accuracy on the archived test set. Rare-defect recall is 61%. Both belong to one evaluation, not a claim of field reliability.

traps.wrong: He invented the model architecture or built the entire system alone.
traps.truth: He used an existing architecture. In a team of four he owned dataset splitting, evaluation and error analysis.

traps.wrong: His workshop submission is an accepted or peer-reviewed publication.
traps.truth: The manuscript is submitted, with no decision yet. Its authors have approved a public preprint.
